note: Typical timing — check exact dates with your school and colleges.

milestones.title: PSAT/NMSQT
milestones.detail: Practice for the SAT. In 11th grade it's also the National Merit Scholarship qualifier.

milestones.title: FAFSA and financial aid forms open
milestones.detail: The FAFSA usually opens around October 1. Some colleges also ask for the CSS Profile.

milestones.title: Last SAT/ACT dates for fall applications
milestones.detail: Many seniors retake the SAT or ACT in October or November.

milestones.title: Update your grades for the new semester
milestones.detail: First semester ends around the end of January — update your GPA and courses here.

milestones.title: Course registration for next year
milestones.detail: Usually in winter or early spring. Plan next year's courses with your counselor.

milestones.title: Take the SAT or ACT
milestones.detail: Spring of 11th grade is a common time for a first official SAT or ACT.

milestones.title: College decisions due
milestones.detail: May 1 is the usual deadline to pick a college and send a deposit.

milestones.title: AP exams
milestones.detail: AP exams are given over two weeks in early-to-mid May.

milestones.title: Build your college list
milestones.detail: The summer before 12th grade is a good time to finish your list and start essays.

milestones.title: Update your grades after the school year
milestones.detail: Second semester ends around the end of June — update your GPA and courses here.
